title: Perp basis
description: How far the perpetual trades from its spot index. A widening basis means leverage is pushing one way faster than spot can follow.

regime.label: Basis regime
regime.description: Rich when the perp is above its index, cheap when below, neutral inside a small band. Rich means leveraged buyers are ahead of spot.

basis_bps.label: Basis
basis_bps.description: Perp mark price minus the spot index as a share of price, in basis points. Positive means the perp is rich to spot.

basis_bps_change_60s.label: Basis change 60s
basis_bps_change_60s.description: How much the basis moved over the last minute, in basis points. A fast change means leverage is repricing.
